q: Why would a seller list with your company (or any other Broker) when they can just put it up on FB or some other online site and sell without a commission?
a: Great question! There are many answers.  In some cases, they may actually sell to a buyer who found them online.  In other cases, Sellers feel more comfortable having an intermediary talk with a prospective buyer.  Sellers don’t always want to discuss their financials with a stranger without knowing anything about the person.  A Broker has a relationship with the Seller and a job to be done on behalf of the Seller.  Also, a Broker can offer a lot of advice about pricing, a bigger reach as far as marketing, and knows how best to present the campground to maximize the Seller’s profit.

q: How does the advertising program work?
a: Simply choose your advertising plan, complete the signup form, and your park gets listed and promoted immediately. Qualified buyer inquiries are sent directly to you so you stay in control of every conversation and negotiation.

We offer three plans. Level 1 at $99 per month includes a professional listing with direct buyer inquiry forwarding. Level 2 at $299 per month adds active Facebook and Instagram promotion. Level 3 at $499 per month includes everything plus professional video content and a dedicated 30 day marketing campaign.

q: Are there any long term contracts?
a: No. All plans are month to month with no long term commitment required. You can start, pause, or cancel at any time.

q: How quickly will I start receiving inquiries?
a: Most advertisers begin receiving inquiries within the first 7 to 14 days of their listing going live. Level 2 and Level 3 plans typically generate faster results due to active social media promotion.
